framed_trials.scope: 104-byte stop-and-wait CRC echo plus completion ACK, queue depth one, Wi-Fi power save on; not gameplay

timing_evidence.mitigation: New probe waits for LE Connection Update Complete for its own handle and target timing before measuring

limitations: Echo probes do not establish game compatibility or gameplay quality.
Host FD prototype retains exported FD copies until single-session teardown; not suitable for production reconnect.
Current measurement has queue depth one; production burst/backpressure handling is not verified.
Role-switch discovery had one timeout; explicit legacy parameter preparation passed one later connection but needs repetition.
Wi-Fi power save is on during current BLE measurements; classic/TCP earlier controls disabled it.

coverage: Negotiated MTU framing and bounded whole-message CRC
Stale epoch, ACK identity, malformed ATT and unrelated HCI events
Owned interval completion and fresh discovery signals
FD peer guard, complete echo/ACK and duplicate acquisition
Bounded fragmented window, queue drain and stale ACK rejection
linux_protocol_tests.wifi_latency_regression: 16 checks passed under ASAN/UBSAN across pacing modes

conclusion: All 400 TCP and 400 repeated classic Bluetooth exchanges passed integrity checks. Classic 104-byte p50 ~33.8ms vs TCP ~4.3ms; classic is not selected as production default. Initial connection abort remains an unresolved transient, not relabelled as success. BLE GATT is still unmeasured.
